exam.subject: english
exam.title: Lesson 1｜Who’s That Young Man?｜困難
exam.subtitle: 15 題｜整合判讀與情境推論
exam.sourceNote: 依 115 學年度康軒版國中英文第一冊 Lesson 1 教材參考資料自編；題型參考 GEPT 初級整合式詞彙、結構與短文判讀四選一形式，非官方 GEPT 試題。

questions.q: Mia is David’s mother. David is Leo’s father. Mia is Leo’s _____.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) grandmother。Mia 是 David 的母親，而 David 是 Leo 的父親，所以 Mia 是 Leo 的 grandmother。

questions.q: Mr. and Mrs. Wang are Tina’s parents. Tina is their _____.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) daughter。Tina 是這對父母的女兒。

questions.q: A: Is that man your father?  B: No, _____. He is my uncle.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) he isn’t。後句說 He is my uncle，表示前面的 father 判斷是否定。
答案是 (A) He is a young man.。單數可數名詞 man 前需要冠詞，形容詞 young 放在名詞前。

questions.q: A: _____  B: She is my sister, Bella.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) Who is she?。回答同時提供姓名與關係，最符合 Who 問句。

questions.q: Bella is nice, but her teacher is very strict. Which sentence is true?
questions.e: 答案是 (B) The teacher is strict.。題幹直接指出 her teacher is very strict。

questions.q: Kevin is a junior high school student. His father is a nurse, his mother is a doctor, and his sister is an English teacher. Who works at a school?
questions.e: 答案是 (C) Kevin’s sister。English teacher 最符合在學校工作的職業；這題需要由職業做情境判讀。

questions.q: Kevin is a junior high school student. His father is a nurse, and his mother is a doctor. Which statement is correct?
o: Kevin’s parents work in health care.
questions.e: 答案是 (C)。nurse 與 doctor 都是醫療相關職業，因此可推知 Kevin 的父母都從事 health care 相關工作。

questions.q: In a family paragraph, you need to find Paul’s job as fast as possible. Which reading action best matches Scanning?
o: Look for “Paul” first, then check the nearby job word.
Read only the title and guess.
questions.e: 答案是 (B)。Scanning 是先鎖定關鍵字，再快速定位特定資訊；找 Paul 的工作就先掃 Paul。

questions.q: Which word does NOT have the same vowel sound as the other three in Lesson 1?
questions.e: 答案是 (D) name。cat, hat, man 為 /æ/；name 在教材中屬 a_e /e/。

questions.q: Which pair has the same vowel sound in Lesson 1?
questions.e: 答案是 (C) rain — cake。教材中 ai 與 a_e 這兩組例字都標示為 /e/。

questions.q: Choose the best correction for: “Who he is?”
questions.e: 答案是 (A) Who is he?。Who 問句的基本語序是 Who + be + subject?

questions.q: This is Nick. _____ a student, and his father _____ a nurse.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) He’s / is。He’s = He is；his father 為單數，搭配 is。

questions.q: A: Nice to meet you.  B: Nice to meet you, too. What is the situation most likely about?
o: Two people meet for the first time.
Someone asks about a job only.
questions.e: 答案是 (A)。Nice to meet you 是初次見面時常用的招呼語。

questions.q: Paul is Nick’s father. Lily is Nick’s mother. Bella is Nick’s sister. Who is Paul’s daughter?
questions.e: 答案是 (B) Bella。Bella 是 Nick 的姊妹，而 Paul 是 Nick 的父親，因此 Bella 也是 Paul 的 daughter。
